visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A pair of hands wearing purple nitrile gloves carefully places a sizzling black clay pot containing stewed chicken and mushrooms onto a square wooden base. The setting is a brightly lit restaurant with other similar pots visible on a wooden table. (2) Close-up shots follow: a spoon lifts chunks of braised pork and sauce over a bowl of white rice, and a white spoon scoops a mound of fluffy white rice from a bowl. (3) The scene shifts to hands holding two small plastic cups being filled with a brown-colored frozen slushie from a dispenser. (4) Detailed close-ups of various dishes are shown in sequence: bubbling yellow-brown chicken stew (Huangmen chicken) with green peppers, a ladle pouring the stew, and a spoon lifting pieces of chicken and potato. (5) A different pot containing white fish slices in a pale yellow soup with red chilies and mushrooms is shown, followed by chopsticks lifting bean sprouts and enoki mushrooms from the pot. (6) A third pot features a creamy yellow Laksa broth being poured over meat, shrimp, and noodles, with close-ups of the fresh shrimp and lifting the noodles. (7) A dry-fried squid dish with cucumbers and red peppers is briefly displayed. (8) The camera pans over four different clay pots arranged on the table. (9) The sequence ends with shots of the slushie machine, the restaurant's interior with red walls featuring martial arts-themed murals and empty wooden seating, and finally an exterior shot of the restaurant's red and black signage against a blue sky.
